diagnostics.store-cores.description: Enable or disable storing of core dumps for diagnostics. Is ignored if mfg_data developer mode is enabled.

diagnostics.upload-cores.description: Enable or disable uploading of core dumps for diagnostics.

diagnostics.dev-keep-cores.description: In development mode, enable or disable keeping core dumps instead of deleting them. Only applies when in development mode.

config.schema-url.description: URL or file path to the configuration schema.

config.config-url.description: URL or file path to the configuration file.

config.fetch-cadence.description: Cadence for fetching the configuration file, in seconds.

^telemetry\\..*$.description: Enable/disable telemetry boolean property. Allows dynamic addition of telemetry.* keys. Will match with metric type up to first semicolon or end of string.

^ndc\\..*$.description: Enable/disable ndc boolean property. Allows dynamic addition of ndc.* keys.

^test\\..*$.description: Allows dynamic addition of test.* keys that are of string type.
